title: Taṇhā
text: 1-3 Sāvatthi || || Yo bhikkhave rūpataṇhāya chandarāgo cittasseso upakkileso || || 4-8 Yo saddataṇhāya || Yo gandhataṇhāya || Yo rasataṇhāya || Yo phoṭṭhabbataṇhāya || Yo dhammataṇhāya chandarāgo cittasseso upakkileso || || 9 Yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno || pe || abhiññāsacchikaraṇīyesu dhammesūti || ||
